_meta.description: The Modules page (openspec/changes/simple-structure-profile). One page of link cards that opens every page the simple menu leaves out: the six modules (Sales, Marketing, Point of sale, Products, Contracts, Loyalty) and three pages that belong to no module. It is a `links` page, the library's typed page of link cards (nextcloud-vue 2.61.0). The library leaves out a card whose route does not resolve, so tests/vitest/modulesPage.spec.js mounts the page and counts all 29. The page exists in both structure profiles so its address is stable; only the simple menu links to it (`ModulesMenu` in src/menu-layout.simple.json). tests/vitest/structureProfile.spec.js fails when a module entry in the simple profile has no card here. ROUND 12 (PqModules): the six modules are module cards (nextcloud-vue 2.92.0 `modules`): a badge says whether the module is in the menu, the pages are linked from the card, Open goes to its first page, and a module that is off links to the admin settings for administrators (main.js fills `enabled` from `menu_modules` and drops that link for everyone else). Every page a module card linked as a card before is still linked, from its module card. The rest are two list cards: Also in Pipelinq and More.
